snippet.title: Flowerbud: A Flower Shop Dating Sim - Announcement Trailer // Showcase
snippet.description:
An early announcement trailer for Flowerbud: A Flower Shop Dating Sim! // STEAM PAGE COMING SOON

This trailer was made for the Rainbow Tech Showcase. Flowerbud is in VERY early development.

STORY:

A second chance. A name you hadn’t spoken in years. And suddenly… you were home.

After a decade, you return  to the town of Flowerbud.

...But the town isn’t how you remember it. Once a familiar place full of life, it is now the opposite: quiet and crumbling. Locals have drifted apart. Tourism has  almost vanished.

 The spirit of the town is fading. It’s up to you to remind the locals of their bonds, restore the land, and perhaps, even find love?

————————

GAME FEATURES

 RECONNECT AND RESTORE: Rebuild trust between villagers, bring life back to the town, and experience deep, branching relationships.

ROMANCE OR FRIENDSHIP: Date a diverse cast, or build a lifelong bond with a 'Best Friend' — no romance required!

YOUR SHOP, YOUR STYLE:  Customize your shop to reflect your personal style and attract unique customers - who knows who may visit?!

 BALANCE WORK AND PLAY: Manage your shop by day, explore and grow your connections at night.

PLAY YOUR WAY:  Choose how YOU want to shape Flowerbud’s future. Multiple endings await!
